name: t2d_controller_probe
description: Base for the chain-budget probe: how much precision do we buy per unit of wall time? Jason measured 10 -> 50 chains costing ~12x runtime, and added --gibbs-reruns N (sequential pooled batches, NOT independent seeds) as a cheaper route to the same effective chain count. Candidates are laid on top of this with --set: c50 = --num-chains 50; c10r5 = --num-chains 10 --gibbs-reruns 5; c10r2 = --num-chains 10 --gibbs-reruns 2; c10 = --num-chains 10. Everything else is held equal, and deliberately: the four Gibbs phase bounds are pinned because main's post-merge default (max_num_restarts 0, stall detection off) still leaves burn-in and post-burn-in free between 10 and 490, so an unpinned probe would confound chain count with sampling budget. --min-gwas-inverse-variance-ratio 0 turns off the QC default that 8adff49 made visible, so this probe measures the controller and not the new HuGE input. --sigma-power -2 is the code default in gibbs mode; it is stated because the local sweep configs override it to 0.
